lines.text: Potiphar, captain of the guard, buys Joseph from the Ishmaelites and puts him in charge of his household.
Potiphar's wife asks Joseph to sleep with her, but he refuses day after day.
When no servant is inside, she grabs his cloak, and Joseph leaves it and runs to the fields.
She tells the servants and then Potiphar that Joseph came to her, and Potiphar burns with shame.
Potiphar has Joseph thrown into the king's prison, where the LORD is with him and the warden puts the prisoners in his care.
